title: Seven Hundred Still a Guess

mood.label: Heavy and uneasy
mood.summary: A world at 42/100 — a Himalayan glacier collapse killed at least 160 with hundreds missing, wildfire haze put millions of Indonesians at risk, missiles hit Kyiv and gunmen seized hundreds in Nigeria, while Qatar flew to Tehran and Senegal made its own sickle cell drug.

lines: The ice let go above the valley and the valley went downstream,
a hundred and sixty counted, seven hundred still a guess.
South, the peat sends weather no one chose,
Singapore breathes Sumatra; Kyiv wakes to missiles again.
A manhunt in Niger State for the hundreds carried off,
a peso past fifteen hundred, a market flat and sour.
In Dakar they made the medicine themselves this time,
and Sunday a telescope goes up to look for worlds.
Forty-two — heavy and uneasy, weight and a thin bright thread,
the mountain that came down, the plane to Tehran instead.
We hold the missing number like a door that won't close,
still here, still counting, still looking up through the smoke.
